summary: Software Engineering undergraduate at the State University of Maringá (UEM), Brazil, focused on data and cloud computing. I combine a technical view of technology with its practical use in business and project management.
At Main - Soluções em Software, I see up close how a technology service comes to life: from the first client conversation to project delivery.
At RR Transportes e Terraplanagem, I bring that perspective to operations, turning day-to-day routines into internal systems and management dashboards.
I look for challenges that demand analytical thinking and connect technology to real results, with the goal of becoming a data engineer.

projects.name: Logistics ERP
projects.summary: System that runs the operation of a trucking company: trips, costs, freight and maintenance, with a dashboard for the manager and an app for the driver that works without signal.
highlights: Financial result per trip, with manager review, commissions and fuel, maintenance and ad-hoc costs backed by receipt photos
Freight compared to the legal minimum rate (ANTT), with versioned tables updated from the official calculator
Expiration and mileage-based maintenance alerts, with push notifications
Security: scrypt-hashed passwords, revocable sessions, login attempt lockout and a strict CSP
Change auditing, daily backups and weekly restore tests
Automated tests (pytest and Playwright) and CI on GitHub Actions, with dependency scanning
projects.architectureTitle: Production architecture, on a Linux VPS
projects.deployment: In production on a Linux VPS, with nginx, HTTPS (Let's Encrypt) and services isolated by systemd

projects.name: This portfolio
projects.summary: Bilingual site and PDF resume generated from a single data file per language. Updating the portfolio means editing that file: the build validates the content and generates everything else.
highlights: Build-time validation: phone numbers, addresses, HTML, credentials and non-HTTPS links block publishing
LaTeX-style PDF resume generated automatically, with an always up-to-date preview on the site
ASCII clouds generated by code: lit 3D volumes with per-character color
No JavaScript on the site, with a strict CSP, security headers and a metadata-free photo
Lighthouse score of 100 for performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO
Active B2B client prospecting and preparation of commercial proposals
Negotiation of technology projects
Requirements structuring and project execution tracking
Support for the daily management of transport and heavy machinery operations
Software design and web architecture for internal systems and dashboards covering freight, fueling and operating costs
Review of transport tax documents (CT-e, MDF-e and delivery receipts) for daily closing and billing
Vehicle entry and exit control in spreadsheets, logging times, routes and incidents for fleet management
Inspection and upkeep of IT equipment: computers, printers and office devices
Organization of tax and personnel records for internal audits and lookups
Review of invoices and sales orders before billing
Maintenance of customer and supplier records in the system
Control spreadsheets and order organization between sales and the warehouse
